notes.title: LIMSCAPE version 1.46 has been released on the beta branch.
notes.notes:
1.45 → 1.46

Fixed an issue where controls became unresponsive when mouse sensitivity was set below 1.

Fixed unnatural reflections occurring in transparent materials when IOR was set to 1 or lower.

If no issues are found, this version will be released on the default branch within 1–2 days.

notes.title: LIMSCAPE version 1.45 has been released on the Beta branch.
notes.notes:
1.43 → 1.45

Major performance improvements through Lumen, VSM, and internal variable optimizations, along with reduced memory usage.

Unreal Engine 5.6’s native upscaler is faster than DLSS. However, since DLSS denoising produces fewer artifacts and cleaner visuals, DLSS remains enabled by default.

\[Sandbox Mode] Added Hit Lighting as an optional toggle for performance considerations. Screen Space Reflections re-enabled (with an enable button inside the Render Settings Actor).

\[Sandbox Mode] Fixed an issue where large Rect Lights would shine through walls.

\[Sandbox Mode] Added “No Shadows” option (necessary because glass materials now cast shadows by default).

\[Sandbox Mode] Added ray-traced shadow option for certain lights.

\[Sandbox Mode] Added a “Select Only” button after object search to allow selecting without moving the object.

\[Sandbox Mode] Added a puddle actor.

\[Sandbox Mode] Changed transparent material shading algorithm to legacy mode for performance reasons (refraction remains supported).

\[Sandbox Mode] Fixed an issue where TextGen actors had black edges, improved resolution, and added support for metallic and emissive properties.

\[Sandbox Mode] Light emission now affects global illumination and reflections by default. Added a Non-Reflective Emission option to revert to the old behavior. (Note: this may cause some areas to appear brighter than before. If areas look too bright or you want highlights to blow out in dark scenes, enable Non-Reflective Emission.)

Adjusted and updated lighting in official levels.

Performance Measurements

NVIDIA RTX 3090 Ti
Scalability: High
Screen Percentage: 50
Resolution: 4K

First Level Opening

Frame Generation Off: ~100 FPS

Frame Generation On: ~180 FPS

AMD RX 7600
Scalability: High
Resolution: 4K
Screen Percentage: 30

First Level Opening

Frame Generation Off: ~70 FPS

Frame Generation On: ~130 FPS


This version is scheduled to be released to the Default branch within the next few days, provided no issues are found.

notes.title: Version 1.43 of LIMSCAPE has been released on the beta branch.
notes.notes:
Optimization and bug fixes after upgrading Unreal Engine from 5.42 to 5.61 in LIMSCAPE 1.40:

Frame Generation implemented via FSR

Added Render Settings Actor, enabling bloom, tint, and contrast adjustments in Sandbox Mode

Fixed issue where DLSS quality selection had no effect

Resolved excessive VRAM usage (~6GB) in versions 1.40 and 1.41

Improved performance of glass material refraction

Improved performance of bloom effects

Adjusted control smoothing curve for a firmer feel

Movement Smoothing 0 now bypasses all smoothing for ultra-sharp controls

How to Access the Beta Restart Steam (if it’s running in the background, right-click the Steam icon in the taskbar and choose "Exit") Right-click LIMSCAPE in your Steam Library Select Properties > Betas > Choose “beta” from the dropdown list

notes.title: LIMSCAPE Version 1.40 Now Available on the Beta Branch
notes.notes:

notes.title: LIMSCAPE Version 1.32 Official Update
notes.notes:
LIMSCAPE Version 1.32 Official Update

・Added the ability for the Sound Player Actor to follow the player and to disable default ambient sounds, allowing for fully custom ambient audio.
・Warp Actors now support viewpoint adjustment, letting you lock the camera to the warp point’s direction upon arrival.
・Fixed an issue where stuttering occurred when starting to run.
・Added a feature to warp directly to cleared save points from the in-level pause menu.
・Resolved an issue where the level name was reset when downloading a level from a URL.
・Implemented measures against an issue where, in some environments, Sandbox Mode characters would automatically move in one direction.
・Added a confirmation prompt when pressing the shutdown button.

notes.title: LIMSCAPE Version 1.30 Official Release Update
notes.notes:
This update (1.30) is the official release version of 1.29 Beta. The update notes include changes since version 1.28.
In this update, we’ve added a DirectX 11 Compatibility Mode that allows gameplay even on PCs that do not support DX12.
In addition, the user level-sharing site LIMSCAPERS has finally launched in beta! Uploading and downloading levels is now dramatically easier.

🆕 Main Updates

■ Main Application (LIMSCAPE 1.30)
・Added DX11 fallback mode (lower quality, but playable on PCs without DX12 support)
・Fixed an issue where the key mapping menu could not be closed with ESC
・Added a button in the UI to directly connect to LIMSCAPERS
・Added support for automatically loading linked content from external URLs and files
・Added a LIMSCAPERS button to the "Create New" screen in SANDBOX MODE

■ Launcher
・Added the ability to load levels from LIMSCAPERS using a URL scheme
・Added support for opening .limscape files by double-clicking them
・Added a launch menu option for DirectX 11 compatibility mode
・Added registry registration for URL/file schemes and icons

■ LIMSCAPERS (External Sharing Site)
・Account registration with Email and Google login support
・Upload levels directly from the game
・Search, edit, and delete levels
・Comment function (can be enabled/disabled)
・Reporting system, status feature, and various counters
・Additional thumbnail settings
・Established EULA and Privacy Policy

notes.title: Patch Notes – LIMSCAPE 1.28
notes.notes:
🔧 Main Improvements & Feature Updates
・Zoom functionality is now available even while moving ・Ladder behavior has been further stabilized ・Swing mount/dismount motion has been made smoother and more natural ・Flashlight Actor has been added ・Rope thickness is now adjustable for Swing and Pendulum Actors ・Default walking speed increased by 10% (from 475 to 522) for more natural movement ・Fixed an issue where running couldn’t be triggered by rapidly pressing Shift (obsolete lock removed) ・Improved player stability when standing on fast-moving Physics objects: if the player stands on a Physics-enabled object and its velocity exceeds 200 (VectorLength), the player is now reset to the previous frame’s position ・Sliders now automatically receive a "slider" tag when inserted ・Removed the ability to climb ladders and swings while holding objects — players now drop held items before mounting ・A "Construction" button has been added to Water Zone Actors, allowing manual refresh of water surface data ・Launcher false-positive antivirus detections have been reduced by removing file polling and self-closing logic; now the launcher window is closed by Unreal Engine directly ・Fixed an issue where the "Running Mode" would reset upon key input ・Fixed an issue where diagonal movement was faster than intended (adjusted for cinematic consistency) ・Fixed an issue where only horizontal movement in water was excessively fast ・In the Movement Settings, the label “Foot step noise” has been renamed to “Walking camera motion” for clarity ・Fixed an issue in Sandbox Mode where Water Zone initialization could fail in lightweight levels ・Zoom speed is now adjustable via settings ・Implemented gamepad and keyboard key remapping functionality ・Fixed an issue where Steam Achievements could be unlocked while in Edit Mode ・Improved the stability of the Time Reversal Actor: autosaves during overlap are now disabled, and problematic rollback logic has been removed ・Actors can now have a separate display name, improving identification during selection and editing ・For Actor-internal selection, added a “Reference” button for additionally selected objects ・Added a setting to adjust or disable Depth of Field to address poor focus at high zoom levels
[hr][/hr]🧱 Level-Specific Fixes
・Level 1: Fixed a gap in the room with aligned pillars where players could fall through ・Level 1: Fixed an issue where exiting water near stairs and guardrails allowed players to escape the level boundaries ・Level 2: Adjusted visuals to prevent the phone from visibly switching states ・Level 4: Adjusted the gap where the small smile ball drops into a hole ・Level 5: Fixed an issue where players could get knocked out at the end of the slider in the spinning disc room (placed knockout prevention actor)
[hr][/hr]🌐 Localization Updates
・Overhauled all key mapping-related translations ・Improved localization for Overlap-related Actor names in all non-English, non-Japanese languages ・French: Corrected “Libraly” to “Librairie” ・French: Corrected “S'il le fait” to “Si vous le faites” ・French: Fixed verb agreement when using plural “elles” ・French: Changed “Glissière” to the more accurate “Glissoire” ・French: Replaced the uncommon “Maillage” with “Mesh”, and corrected “matériau” to the proper plural “matériaux” where necessary ・Added translation for “Zoom Sensitivity”

notes.title: LIMSCAPE Version 1.24 Update – June 30, 2025
notes.notes:
\[Update Details]

・Improved systems suspected to cause abnormal screen darkness
・Removed DLSS Frame Generation (plugin completely deleted)
　└ Addresses launch failure related to “sl.pcl.dll” on some systems
・Disabled scaling on Slider Actor (to prevent game freezes)
・Minor adjustments to official levels
[hr][/hr]
Starting with this update, the previous version of LIMSCAPE is now available under the “Previous” branch.
To access it, please restart Steam first — the branch may not appear in the dropdown otherwise.
Then right-click LIMSCAPE in your Steam library → \[Properties] → \[Betas] → select “Previous” from the dropdown menu.

If the game was working before and no longer functions properly after an update, please try switching to this branch.
[hr][/hr]
Future updates will follow a similar approach, with a Beta branch made available ahead of the official release. This will allow you to try out the latest changes in advance.

We’ve received a lot of valuable feedback and suggestions — thank you!
We're actively working through them, and this particular update addresses several high-priority issues.
If you're experiencing problems like failure to launch or extreme screen darkness, this update is expected to resolve those issues.

We highly recommend updating, and thank you as always for your support!

notes.title: LIMSCAPE – Full Release Time, Pricing, and Regional Launch Adjustment Notice
notes.notes:
We previously announced a global release date of June 27,
but the release time was set based on Japan Standard Time (JST),
which means that in many regions, the game will actually launch on June 26.
We sincerely apologize for any confusion this may have caused.



The release will take place at the following times:



・Tokyo (Japan): June 27 at 2:00 AM
・Los Angeles (West Coast US): June 26 at 10:00 AM
・New York (East Coast US): June 26 at 1:00 PM
・London (UK): June 26 at 6:00 PM
・Paris / Berlin (Central Europe): June 26 at 7:00 PM
・Beijing / Seoul: June 27 at 2:00 AM
・Sydney (Australia): June 27 at 3:00 AM



The base price will be $9.99 USD,
with a 10% launch discount available for the first 7 days.



We sincerely apologize for the earlier miscommunication,

notes.title: LIMSCAPE Version 1.22 Update – June 25, 2025
notes.notes:
Updated movement controls in SANDBOX mode
Movement with WASD(QE) + Right Drag now behaves almost identically to Unreal Engine and Unity.

Alt + Left Drag to rotate around pivot

Mouse Wheel now moves the camera forward/backward based on the focus point

New shortcut keys for SANDBOX object manipulation

1 key: Move

2 key: Scale

3 key: Rotate

Fixed an issue where Vsync and scalability settings were reset on restart

Removed jump functionality tied to mouse movement

Fixed a minor bug in the final stage (Stage 5)

notes.title: LIMSCAPE Version 1.21 Update – June 24, 2025

Improved slider performance in sandbox mode

Fixed an issue where the rewind feature would roll back all progress after long exploration
(Added “Stop on Ground Contact” option, enabled by default)

Other fixes for level object behavior and visibility area settings

notes.title: LIMSCAPE FULL VERSION Launch — June 27 (Fri)
notes.notes: The wait is finally over — LIMSCAPE FULL VERSION will be released on June 27th (Fri)! With the full version, players can fully experience the world of LIMSCAPE, from mysterious exploration to creative sandbox building. Thank you for all your support throughout the development — and this is just the beginning. We hope you enjoy LIMSCAPE, create your own worlds, and share your adventures!
